description: Automatic tables whose width differs from their columns' max-content widths, distributed as Chromium 153 does (Blink's DistributeInlineSizeToComputedInlineSizeAuto): an invoice table with a 100px header cell at width 100% (the excess goes to the auto columns in proportion to their max-content widths; the fixed column keeps its width), automatic, and narrower than its columns (at their minimum), switched at run time; two fixed columns only (they take the excess in proportion to their widths); a 25% column beside an auto and a fixed column; and a <col> width
